summary: RXO, Inc. filed an 8-K on October 5, 2026, disclosing an Agreement and Plan of Merger dated October 4, 2026, under which C.H. Robinson Worldwide, Inc. will acquire RXO through a two-step merger via Merger Sub Inc. and Viking Logistics LLC. RXO will become a wholly owned C.H. Robinson subsidiary. The RXO board unanimously approved the deal and recommends stockholders adopt the merger agreement. The transaction is expected to close in the first half of 2027. Consideration terms, including any election mechanics, remain partially disclosed in the filing excerpt. Watch regulatory approvals and shareholder vote timing.
